game_name: Adventure Quiz Capcom World 2 (Japan 920611, B-Board 90629B-3, no battery)
general_issues: Select cworld2ja.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. TPO automatically assigns up to 2 computers. Each computer controls one player on the shared cabinet using its Player 1 controls. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
